# Sinric Pro Documentation

> Sinric Pro is an IoT cloud platform that connects ESP32, ESP8266, Raspberry Pi Pico W and other development boards to Amazon Alexa, Google Home, Samsung SmartThings, Apple HomeKit (Homebridge), Home Assistant, a mobile app and a REST API. This site is the official documentation: setup guides, step-by-step hardware tutorials with complete code, device type and capability references, and API guides.

Key facts:

- Website: https://sinric.pro
- Portal (create devices, get credentials): https://portal.sinric.pro
- Arduino library for ESP32, ESP8266 and RP2040: `SinricPro` (https://github.com/sinricpro/esp8266-esp32-sdk). Install it from the Arduino Library Manager, or add `sinricpro/SinricPro` to `lib_deps` in PlatformIO.
- Other SDKs: ESP-IDF, Raspberry Pi Pico, MicroPython, Python, NodeJS. See https://github.com/sinricpro
- REST API reference: https://apidocs.sinric.pro
- MCP server for AI coding assistants (documentation search, API reference, SDK examples): https://docs.sinric.pro/mcp. Setup: {{ site.url }}/pages/mcp-server
